comment: * Wraps a byte array, providing methods that allow it to be read as a Vorbis bitstream. * * @see Vorbis bitpacking * specification

methods.name: public void reset()
methods.comment: Resets the reading position to zero.

methods.name: public boolean readBit()
methods.comment:
* Reads a single bit.
   *
   * @return {@code true} if the bit is set, {@code false} otherwise.

methods.name: public int readBits(int numBits)
methods.comment:
* Reads up to 32 bits.
   *
   * @param numBits The number of bits to read.
   * @return An integer whose bottom {@code numBits} bits hold the read data.

methods.name: public void skipBits(int numBits)
methods.comment:
* Skips {@code numberOfBits} bits.
   *
   * @param numBits The number of bits to skip.

methods.name: public int getPosition()
methods.comment: Returns the reading position in bits.

methods.name: public void setPosition(int position)
methods.comment:
* Sets the reading position in bits.
   *
   * @param position The new reading position in bits.

methods.name: public int bitsLeft()
methods.comment: Returns the number of remaining bits.
